mapper.sql: SELECT t.in_id, t.inbound_no, t.pending_id, t.book_id, i.book_name, i.isbn, t.in_num, t.in_time, t.operator_id, t.in_reason, u.nick_name AS operator_name, t.supplier, t.supplier_phone, t.unit_price, t.total_price, t.remark, t.del_flag FROM textbook_in t LEFT JOIN textbook_info i ON t.book_id = i.book_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.operator_id = u.user_id WHERE t.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: AND t.inbound_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{inboundNo},'%') AND t.book_id = #{bookId} AND i.book_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{bookName},'%') AND i.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%',#{isbn},'%') AND t.supplier LIKE CONCAT('%',#{supplier},'%') ORDER BY t.in_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO textbook_in(inbound_no, pending_id, book_id, book_name, isbn, in_num, in_time, operator_id, in_reason, supplier, supplier_phone, unit_price, total_price, remark, del_flag) VALUES(#{inboundNo}, #{pendingId}, #{bookId}, #{bookName}, #{isbn}, #{inNum}, NOW(), #{operatorId}, #{inReason}, #{supplier}, #{supplierPhone}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalPrice}, #{remark}, '0')
mapper.update:
UPDATE textbook_in
inbound_no=#{inboundNo}, pending_id=#{pendingId}, book_id=#{bookId}, in_num=#{inNum}, in_reason=#{inReason}, unit_price=#{unitPrice}, total_price=#{totalPrice}, supplier=#{supplier}, remark=#{remark},
WHERE in_id=#{inId} AND del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: UPDATE textbook_in SET del_flag='1' WHERE in_id=#{inId}
UPDATE textbook_in SET del_flag='1' WHERE in_id IN #{inId}
mapper.select: AND t.pending_id = #{purchaseId} ORDER BY t.in_time DESC
